applicableAreas: Building 1 and Building 8 locations adjacent to Valley View Road
findings.comment: Buildings are proposed 26.1 feet (Building 1) and 33.3 feet (Building 8) from Valley View Road property line where overhead electric lines exist. However, no surveyed conductor elevations, building elevation sheets, or section views showing vertical clearances from the outer conductor to building faces are provided. Compliance with 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All proposed customer facilities including buildings, parking areas, and utility features
findings.comment: No clearance exhibits, dimension lines, or technical notes demonstrate that proposed facilities maintain minimum 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors. Compliance cannot be verified from available evidence.

applicableAreas: Proposed building locations near Valley View Road overhead facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets or architectural details showing proposed building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roof lines) and their clearances from overhead electric conductors are provided. Both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1 and 8 adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way where overhead facilities exist
findings.comment: No surveyed overhead conductor elevations, building elevation sheets, or section views showing dimension lines from the outside conductor to building faces are provided. Required clearance verification that permanent 7.5-foot horizontal and 15-foot radial clearances are maintained cannot be performed.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1 through 8 proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors, required to demonstrate clearances are met, are not included in the site plan submission. Submitted plans are limited to civil/site planning documents without architectural elevations showing conductor elevation data relative to buildings.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and structures near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits showing dimension lines from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and building projections for clearance verification are not provided. Dimension annotations required to verify both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances are absent from all submitted sheets.

applicableAreas: Internal driveways and parking areas proposed on site
findings.comment: No vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric lines to finished driveway grades are shown. Required minimum clearances (16 feet for parking without truck traffic, 18 feet for areas with truck traffic) cannot be verified. No registered surveyor mid-span clearance measurements provided to verify conductor sag and actual clearance.

applicableAreas: All overhead clearance dimensions on site plan sheets
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on any plan sheets, making it impossible to assess whether any dimensions present are measured from pole centerline versus outside conductor. This measurement methodology critical to code compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings and structures proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations, conductor elevations, and mid-span clearances is not provided. When overhead facilities' vertical clearance to proposed site features appears marginal (buildings 26-33 feet from overhead line), surveyor field data verifying actual clearance distances is required but absent.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line runs; tree locations measured 3.3 feet and 0 feet from OHE line
findings.comment: Trees are proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (measured distances 3.3 feet and 0 feet from OHE line per measure-distance tool). Landscape plan proposes 2 Live Oak and 10 Cedar Elm trees but contains no note specifying that these species are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F or that minimum clearance distances are maintained. If trees are not utility-compatible species (required for placement within 10 lateral feet), this is a code violation.

applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformers shown on Sheet 21 electrical design plan
findings.comment: Transformers are shown on the electrical design plan, but no surveyed vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric conductors to the top of transformer equipment are provided in section view. No section exhibit showing clearance between conductors and transformer components is included.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes applicable to entire site development
findings.comment: Plans do not include the required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. This notation is required on cover sheet or general notes and is absent from submitted site plan.
